article.headline: Timberwolves host Clippers Friday for NBA Cup group stage matchup
article.description: Los Angeles Clippers (1-3, 12th in the Western Conference) vs. Minnesota Timberwolves (3-2, eighth in the Western Conference)
article.title: Timberwolves host Clippers Friday for NBA Cup group stage matchup
article.linkText: Timberwolves host Clippers Friday for NBA Cup group stage matchup
article.story: Los Angeles Clippers (1-3, 12th in the Western Conference) vs. Minnesota Timberwolves (3-2, eighth in the Western Conference) Minneapolis; Friday, 8 p.m. EDT LINE: Timberwolves -9.5; over/under is 230.5 BOTTOM LINE: The Los Angeles Clippers travel to play the Los Angeles Clippers in an NBA Cup in-season tournament group play matchup. Minnesota went 49-33 overall and 31-21 in Western Conference action last season. The Timberwolves averaged 118.0 points per game last season, 19.0 from the free-throw line and 41.4 from 3-point range. Los Angeles went 42-40 overall and 25-27 in Western Conference play during the 2025-26 season. The Clippers averaged 113.8 points per game while shooting 48.4% from the field and 36.8% from behind the arc last season. INJURIES: Timberwolves: Donte DiVincenzo: out (achilles), Anthony Edwards: out (knee). Clippers: Max Strus: out (foot), Yanic Konan Niederhauser: out (lisfranc), Jordan Miller: out (shoulder), Brandon Ingram: out (heel), Rui Hachimura: out (quad), Bradley Beal: out (knee). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
